2912237.sourceDescription: Pop this 3ft white Christmas tree in any corner and you've got instant festive cheer without the fuss. It's compact enough to fit where a full-size tree won't, making it perfect for smaller spaces, bedrooms or even your workspace. The snow white finish gives it a clean, wintry look that works with any colour scheme you're planning. Setup's straightforward with minimal assembly needed, and it comes with its own white stand to keep it steady. Made from PVC with flat needles and 121 tips, it's got enough fullness to hang baubles and lights without looking sparse, and it's fire retardant for peace of mind indoors. . xmw180kp.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
xmw180kp.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Bulbs Pre-lit Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 180 cm
xmw180kp.sourceDescription: This Christmas tree gives you the same impression as that of a real one. It can be quickly and easily assembled. The Christmas tree has more than 540 different white branches, all of them can be aligned individually. A couple of the branches has white tips. The included pinecones and white tips make this tree perfectly festive for the Christmas holidays. The Christmas tree stands on a sturdy base for optimal stability. When Christmas is over you can dissemble the tree so you can store it in a store-saving manner, ready to use for the next year. The artificial Christmas tree is durable in use for years, so there is no need to take a tree down each year. It is also economical because you only need one tree for years which will cut your costs throughout the years. Featuring energy-efficient LED lights, it lights up beautifully and creates a cosy holiday atmosphere. What's more, decorated with the beautiful peak and balls, this Xmas tree will be eye-catching in your home. Note: The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Shiny rose gold, matt rose gold and glitter rose gold Total height: 180 cm Stand diameter: 40 cm Tree diameter: 90 cm Number of pinecones: 12 Stand included: Yes LED string light length: 15 m Voltage: DC 5 V Power: 5 W Number of branches: 540 With 150 LEDs With USB connection Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand 1 x LED string light 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball Maximum 110 kg per seat. Be aware of the risk of open fires and other sources of strong heat in the vicinity of the product. GPSR • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

mekrgnxg.sourceDescription: Add a warm and traditional finishing touch to your festive décor with this 50cm Christmas Wreath, beautifully arranged with pine cones, vibrant red berries, green foliage and decorative red floral accents. The rich combination of classic Christmas colours creates a full and eye-catching display that instantly adds seasonal charm to your home. Measuring approximately 50cm in diameter, this large festive wreath is perfect for displaying on front doors, internal doors, walls, fireplaces and mantelpieces. Its layered foliage, rustic pine cones and bright berry detailing provide an attractive traditional look that works beautifully with farmhouse, rustic, classic and contemporary Christmas décor. Whether used as a welcoming Christmas front door decoration or as part of an indoor festive display, this decorative wreath makes it easy to transform your home for the Christmas season. A versatile addition to your collection of Christmas decorations, it can be styled alongside garlands, fairy lights, candles and other seasonal accessories. Large 50cm Christmas wreath: Measuring approximately 50cm in diameter, this generously sized festive wreath creates an impressive Christmas display on doors, walls, fireplaces and around the home. Red berries & pine cone design: Beautifully decorated with clusters of vibrant red berries, rustic pine cones, rich green foliage and striking red floral accents for a traditional festive appearance. Beautiful Christmas door decoration: An eye-catching choice for decorating your front door or internal doors and creating a warm, welcoming look for family, friends and Christmas guests. Full & layered festive appearance: The combination of foliage, berries, pine cones and decorative detailing gives the wreath a rich, full appearance that complements traditional, rustic, farmhouse and contemporary Christmas themes. Versatile festive home décor: More than just a Christmas door wreath – display it on a wall, above a fireplace, over a mantelpiece or incorporate it into your existing Christmas decorations for an attractive seasonal centrepiece. Neo direct ltd. Butterley street, leeds, ls10 1aw Neo Direct Ltd, Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW, United Kingdom

gn5bgm42.sourceDescription: Bring the colours and textures of autumn into your home with this decorative wreath. Its arrangement of pumpkins, pinecones, leaves and seasonal foliage creates a welcoming display for Halloween, Thanksgiving and other autumn gatherings. Use the included vine string to hang the wreath on a door, or lay it flat as a centrepiece for your dining table. Measuring 45cm across, it makes a noticeable seasonal statement without requiring real foliage. Made from plastic, polyester and Styrofoam, the artificial design can be stored and reused for future celebrations. It requires no watering or ongoing upkeep—simply dust it occasionally to keep it looking fresh. Key Features: Artificial autumn arrangement with pumpkins, pinecones and leaves Suitable for doors, walls and tabletop displays Includes vine string for hanging Reusable design for multiple autumn seasons No watering or seasonal foliage maintenance required Round wreath in an orange colourway Materials: plastic, polyester and Styrofoam Weight: 0.7kg Dimensions: H45cm x W45cm x D10cm Includes 1 wreath Please refer to packaging and/or manual for relevant information Benross Marketing Ltd, 22 Goodlass Road, Liverpool, L24 9HJ, United Kingdom

It can be hung on a wall or door, or displayed as a free-standing decoration on a mantelpiece or dining table. • Red decorative Christmas wreath with a 60 cm outer diameter. • Includes a hanging loop. • Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.
